data.guideTextData: Desperate times occasionally call for some scheming. If the bakery never became popular, surely Santi would no longer be blocked?

data.actualQuestTextData: Find out where the phrase “No matter the price” can be used.
data.guideTextData: The phrase must have some significance somewhere, perhaps Santi and Liezel ought to go back to Rommel’s place and the museum and investigate.

storedDialogues: LIEZEL "— I decided to gift upon them an heirloom that has remained in our family for generations, may all who hold it share our ambitions to share the beauty of Giyala to all of the world."
LIEZEL The other half of the passage has been torn... Oh, but there’s more.
LIEZEL “When I took my seat, I never expected to be surrounded by cowards. I thought we were the ones who swore to fight."
LIEZEL "The ones who took real action, unlike those idiots in the Kapisanan who cling to the esoteric…"
LIEZEL “I must take action and wield the fate of the Disidensiyang Giyala in my own hands. Those bastards will not respond to reason."
LIEZEL "My only hope of being understood lies with Servillano—If I can convince him then perhaps-”
LIEZEL It cuts off there. Whatever his plans were, Servillano must not have approved, judging by the state of things now.
SANTI Maybe you can find the other half of those passages? He might have written everything down.
LIEZEL We would not know unless we were to see it. Let us keep investigating.
LIEZEL Hello there, may I ask something?
MAID Morn-... I mean, good afternoon madame. Welcome again, to the household. What can I do for you? Are you feeling peckish?
LIEZEL No, I was wondering if there was anything wrong with Rommel recently?
MAID Wrong? Whatever do you mean madame?
LIEZEL Well, I spoke to him earlier, and it feels as if something otherworldly struck him. Like, he is not himself...?
LIEZEL Sorry, the question may be too personal for your-
MAID No no. I also sensed something weird with Master Rommel. I don’t mean to be malicious against him, but every night, as I’m about to end my shift...
MAID I keep hearing murmurs in Rommel’s office.
MAID Just a few nights ago, the door was slightly open. I was really curious and wanted to take a peek.
MAID Master Rommel was writing furiously in a journal. I swear he looked like a different person.
LIEZEL Was there anything particularly noteworthy with this journal?
MAID Not really, but I did find its red cover appealing. I didn’t want to pry inside my master’s thoughts though...
LIEZEL Thank you for telling me this, he must be having a really hard time recently.
MAID Yeah, it’s been getting difficult to work with all these magic terror attacks happening.
LIEZEL ... I’ll be taking my leave, have a good day.
MAID Oh! Before you go, please have a treat. I’ve been making this all morning.
MAID I always love eating the pastries from the local bakery. So, I decided to make one myself!
LIEZEL Oh...?
LIEZEL (Is that a burnt spot? It’s somehow soft and hard at the same time... Though, I don’t want to refuse such an effort...)
LIEZEL Thank you, I’ll be enjoying this on my way home...
MAID Thank you madame... Also, please don’t tell Master Rommel of our conversation please? I don’t want to go searching for a job again...

LIEZEL (... This quite honestly looks like it would give me food poisoning.)
LIEZEL That… is a peculiar painting. It is certainly novel.
LIEZEL It looks so real. Like it’s coming out... (Wait, it is coming out! The tips of these flowers can be pressed.)
LIEZEL (I see. Rommel must be hiding something important behind this painting. The tips are pointing in different directions. Another combination lock.)
LIEZEL Santi, I found what seems to be a safe. Though, it requires a unique combination. It looks like I will need your help again.
SANTI Could clues to something that small have survived for so long?
LIEZEL It has worked out for us so far, has it not?
SANTI ... True.
LIEZEL I guess I need to press the arrows in the right order somehow...
LIEZEL Phew. I got it. That wasn’t so hard.
LIEZEL This letter... It is stamped with a seal of the Congregation!
SANTI The Congregation? Like the CWS?
SANTI Those are the guys you’re fighting, right? The ones that used to own Giyala?
LIEZEL Yes, this... (Is Rommel in correspondence with the Congregation? Our very enemy?)
LIEZEL (Has he gone mad? I always took him to be someone that valued the good fight—everything else aside.)
LIEZEL (What could have happened?)
LIEZEL I will open the letter.
SANTI But won’t he see it’s been tampered with?
LIEZEL Learning the truth is far more important... But I will ensure to return it as it was with magic.
SANTI Alright... So what does it say?
LIEZEL “The secrets of these walls are hidden behind the faces of frauds. You do not have my fealty, but I will do what must be done. This country will no longer be sullied by those hypocrites.”
LIEZEL ... That is all.
SANTI I don’t understand. Is there actually something hidden in his walls?
LIEZEL I fear... This letter goes deeper than that. He bears a deep hatred for whoever he is calling “those hypocrites”. Enough to convince him to listen to the Congregation
SANTI But where does this lead us?
SANTI ...
SANTI (No reply...? Maybe I can continue with my investigation first. The letter must be hinting at something.”)
LIEZEL (I cannot afford to be distracted right now. I need to know who is causing these “attacks”.)
BAKERY OWNER Everyone! If I may have your attention!
BAKERY OWNER I am pleased to announce that we have a new recipe we will be sharing today! Our celebrity guest here will be trying the first bite of the day!
BAKERY OWNER We can assure you that it is the best thing you will ever taste! Enough to satisfy your families for generations!
LIEZEL (Quite the statement, but it seems like it was not for show. There are quite a few big names in this crowd—even that Celebrity that has been all over the press lately.)
BAKERY OWNER And we are proud to say that no foul magic was used in its creation either, haha!
LIEZEL (... Was that a necessary addition?)
LIEZEL (This feels a bit laughably cruel.)
CELEBRITY Finally, I can try it!
CELEBRITY ...
CELEBRITY Ew, this is disgusting! I cannot believe I waited all day for such garbage.
CELEBRITY You can count on me never returning to this establishment!
CELEBRITY For a business like this to stoop to such harsh and untrue marketing...
CELEBRITY Hmph, nobody can be trusted these days.
BAKERY OWNER W-Waaait!!! Oh no, what happened to this bread!?
TOWNSPERSON L-Look at how that celebrity reacted...
SCARED TOWNSPERSON For such a renowned bakery to produce such foul bread... Could it be a mangkukulam?
LIEZEL (Well, I suppose they are not far off, but I needed no magic for that.)
LIEZEL (... Was the maid’s bread really so bad to warrant such a reaction...? I was expecting a little displeasure, at best.)
LIEZEL (It made that Celebrity leave in a hurry. She must be embarrassed—she was supposed to be endorsing the product, after all.)
TOUR GUIDE Haha, Senator Mahalia Lapuz got into a real big controversy because she was cracking down on illegal gambling rings...
TOUR GUIDE Only to get exposed for hosting chicken fighting gambling parties.
TOUR GUIDE Still, I can’t disparage her reputation too much, she was the one who first had the museum built, after all.
SANTI Oh, I didn’t know this museum was so young.
TOUR GUIDE A lot of things had to be rebuilt after the war—the museum used to be the Lapuz Family Manor, but it was heavily damaged.
TOUR GUIDE Senator Lapuz decided mid-renovations to have it turned into a museum... Likely as a publicity stunt to turn her reputation around. And it worked, funnily enough.
TOUR GUIDE ... Well, it’s not funny if you really think about it, but at least I have a job.
TOUR GUIDE The third was a former mayor of Sumpagita, Mayor Fidel Lapuz, who was known for travelling around the world, gathering information to bring back for Sumpagita!
SANTI Kinda sounds like he just liked travelling.
TOUR GUIDE ... Well, that’s the part we usually don’t say out loud.
TOUR GUIDE He was also the one who had this statue built, to cement Rommel Lapuz’s contribution to our hometown of Sumpagita forever.
SANTI You know, so far all of these people sound... Not as impressive as Rommel.
TOUR GUIDE Well there’s a world of difference between someone who led soldiers on the front lines to protect people and... politicians who grew up rich.

TOUR GUIDE Anyways, let me finish the story. The last person was Sir Teodoro Lapuz, who became the head of the Department of Education, he’s the reason Rommel’s name and deeds have survived in textbooks.
SANTI What’s the fun fact about him?
TOUR GUIDE Haha, he owned a chess set that had a piece made fully out of solid, real gold. After pictures of his house got out, people started accusing him of pocketing funding.
SANTI Are you... allowed to mention all of these controversies?
TOUR GUIDE Well, you’re the only person I’ve gotten to tell all this in a while. It would be a shame if I spent the day telling you lies.
TOUR GUIDE Besides, with all the things Sumpagita is going through lately... I’m just not in the mood to butter up all these people.
TOUR GUIDE Anyways, that’s that story done. Is there anything else you want to know?
SANTI Then... What about Rommel? What did he do after the war?
TOUR GUIDE ... Um... Are you seriously asking?
SANTI Y-Yes...?
TOUR GUIDE Haha, you have a long way to go in your history journey if you don’t know something like that.
TOUR GUIDE He became the first president of Giyala.
ANIKA What were you doing with that Tour Guide in front of our great Señor Rommel?
SANTI Excuse me?
ANIKA Yep! I’m talking to you!
SANTI Well, I, uh... He was just telling me about this statue-
ANIKA "This statue"? You don’t know about our great Señor Rommel? How come? He literally saved Giyala. Even Señor Servillano couldn’t match his wits.
SANTI Huh. You know about Servillano too?
ANIKA Address them properly! Have you no respect for the greatest leaders of our country?
SANTI ...Señor Servillano then.
ANIKA There, good! Yes, I know about the Disidensya leaders from even before the war, especially the great Señor Rommel!
ANIKA I mean she’s not wrong at all, but she didn’t even tell the story about our great Señor Rommel—only his descendants! People these days...
SANTI I didn’t really ask for his story...
ANIKA Don’t be one of them! Historical revisionism is going to be a threat one day!
ANIKA The truth must remain in the right hands! Especially the legacy of the great Señor Rommel!
SANTI What exactly do you know that the tour guide doesn’t? You might just be lying to—I don’t know—rob me.
ANIKA What!? No!?
ANIKA Even the great Señor Rommel did not rob anyone! Except for Señor Servillano’s trust... and their circle of leaders, but...
ANIKA No, I’m just someone who wants people to learn about the great Señor Rommel in full authenticity!
SANTI (This guy’s followers are just as suspicious as him...)
ANIKA I only follow the footsteps of the great Señor Rommel, young Giyalan... If you wish to know more about him, I can tell you.
SANTI Surely, there’s a catch-
ANIKA Clever! You’re absorbing the intelligence and wit of the great Señor Rommel...
SANTI (Isn’t it easier to just refer to him as Rommel?)
ANIKA Okay. Here’s the catch. Give me something as worthy as the great Señor Rommel and I will give you a part of his story that no one in this town will know these days...
SANTI (I don’t know if I can trust this girl. She’s being weird.)
SANTI (But then again... I need as much information as I can get to help Liezel...)
ANIKA So? What do you say?
SANTI Sure... I’ll see what I can give you.
ANIKA Treat this as an offering to the great Señor Rommel and all the gratitude he deserves from this country!
SANTI Okay...
ANIKA Is that...
SANTI ... Hm?
ANIKA IT’S THE GREAT SEÑOR ROMMEL’S!
ANIKA Oh, thank you- THANK YOU so much for finding this gem. I will surely treasure it and bury it with me underground when my time comes.
ANIKA You should be named a hero of Giyala. At least...in my historical memory.
SANTI Haha... No, thank you.
ANIKA Anywho! As a reward for your invaluable contribution to our history, I will now share with you one of the great Señor Rommel’s favorite and exclusive phrases...
SANTI Exclusive phrases? Is it that special?
ANIKA I swear, people have forgotten the significance of the great Señor Rommel’s finest words...
ANIKA If there was one ideology that marks the great Señor Rommel, it is the fact that he clings to whatever he thinks is right. No excuses or detours. Straight towards his goals.
ANIKA If it was for the future of Giyala that he believed, he would have dropped everything. No matter the price.
SANTI “No matter the price...”
ANIKA Mhm yes... He’s mentioned it on numerous occasions...
ANIKA That was the great distinction of the great Señor Rommel to his fellow leaders, especially Señor Servillano, his most trusted friend.
SANTI I’ve heard of their leadership going hand in hand from Liez- I- I mean the tour guide... That Giyala was in a stable position when they were leading together.
ANIKA Some people say the great Señor Rommel and Señor Servillano had a big misunderstanding that caused them to see each other as enemies in the end.
ANIKA It’s easy to believe that because of what happened.
SANTI Well, that locket does have him in it. They must have been close.
ANIKA Huh... Interesting... Is Señor Servillano the reason why the great Señor Rommel had no children?
SANTI Um, what?
ANIKA I believe I will be occupied for years to come because of this token! And you have your reward! Remember: No matter the price!
SANTI (That phrase... I think it could be a key to something...)
SANTI Liezel, I might have something for you.
LIEZEL Oh? What is it?
SANTI Do you know about this phrase: “No matter the price”?
LIEZEL Hm. I do, in fact. That is one quote that Señor Rommel ends almost every speech with. Are you not familiar with it?
SANTI Nope. I just found out about it now from Anika.
LIEZEL Who is this Anika?
SANTI A really big fan of Rommel. Not even joking about the “really big fan” part.
LIEZEL I suppose Señor Rommel’s charm reached some people of the future.
SANTI Or maybe Anika’s just... Obsessed.
LIEZEL An obsession with Señor Rommel. Does that mean his name has made a mark in Sumpagita somehow?
SANTI Well, Anika claims he’s the true hero of Giyala.
LIEZEL (A hero who does anything for his own goals no matter the price? I wonder if he ever carried that ideology with good values...)
LIEZEL That phrase may be of importance since it involves Señor Rommel. We may need to look into this further.
SANTI How though? Where can we use a phrase like that?
LIEZEL ... That novel painting, perhaps? The phrase must be used for something relating to Señor Rommel.
LIEZEL Santi, if you are able, see if that phrase would be of use in the museum. Meanwhile, I have to find out if this connects to anything in Señor Rommel’s house, which I hope it is.
SANTI Okay. I’ll see what I find.
SANTI Hmm...
SANTI Hmm...
SANTI (Oh-! Did I break it?)
SANTI (It went back out. It reminds me of a padlock.)
SANTI Hmm...
SANTI (I didn’t think that would work...)
SANTI (Who would hide something so intricately, inside a museum of all places?)
